topics.title: Units and the International System of Units

concepts.learning_objective: Distinguish base units from derived units and express a derived unit in SI base units.
Identify the seven SI base quantities and their units.
Define plane angle and solid angle and state their units, radian and steradian.
Apply the rules to count the significant figures in a reported measurement.
Write a measurement in scientific notation and find its order of magnitude.

topics.title: Arithmetic with significant figures, rounding off and uncertainty

concepts.learning_objective: Report the result of addition, subtraction, multiplication or division with the correct precision.
Round off uncertain digits using the conventions given in the chapter.
Estimate the uncertainty of a result calculated from measured values.

topics.title: Dimensions, dimensional formulae and dimensional equations

concepts.learning_objective: State the dimensions of a physical quantity in terms of the base quantities.
Write and interpret the dimensional formula and dimensional equation of a quantity.
Use the principle of homogeneity of dimensions to check the consistency of an equation.
Deduce the relation among physical quantities by dimensional analysis.
Explain why a dimensionally consistent equation need not be correct.
